cover.report_type: Year-End Report: January 31 of each year

_meta.notes: Typed form; Year-End box checked, signed 1/31/11 (the year-end report for calendar 2010). Neither amendment box is checked.

contributions.detail: exact (10,750.00 = 10,750.00); 25 rows sum to the attachment's own printed 'Total Contributions - Period Ending 12/31/10  $10,750.00', which equals Summary Page line 1 Column A

expenditures.detail: exact (23,701.14 = 23,701.14); 16 rows sum to the attachment's own printed 'Total Expenses - Period Ending 12/31/10  $23,701.14', which equals Summary Page line 2 Column A

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: The on-form schedules (p3 Schedule A, p5 Schedule B) carry only 'See Attached' and their SUBTOTAL and TOTAL cells are COMPLETELY EMPTY - so no on-form gate exists on either side. Gate taken at each attachment's own printed period total instead, and both close to the cent: contributions rows 10,750.00 = printed 10,750.00; expenditures rows 23,701.14 = printed 23,701.14. Both attachment totals explicitly say 'Period Ending 12/31/10', so they are period figures, not cumulative.
itemized.escalation_note: pp.4 and 6 are LANDSCAPE attachments and they are rotated in OPPOSITE directions in the PDF - p4 needed rotate -90 (clockwise) and p6 needed rotate +90 (counter-clockwise); each was re-rendered at 300 dpi and tight-cropped to the table, and p6 took a second crop after the first one cut off the whole Date column. That is why the sign is per file (and here per PAGE), never per corpus. Every row was read in those crops, hence verified=1.
itemized.notes: 6-page filing (Sim Gill, District Attorney, Year-End; schedule header boxes typed 'Gill / 1/31/11', paginated 3 of 4 and 4 of 4 while the PDF has 6 pages). p1 cover, p2 Summary Page, p3 on-form Schedule A ('See Attached', all total cells EMPTY), p4 the contributions attachment (landscape), p5 on-form Schedule B ('See Attached', all total cells EMPTY), p6 the expenditures attachment (landscape). Both attachments are born-digital spreadsheet prints headed 'Contributions' / 'Expenditures' with a period total labelled 'Period Ending 12/31/10'. The contributions attachment splits the donor name into FIRST NAME and LAST NAME columns, with organisations written entirely in the First Name column and the Last Name cell left empty - the two are joined here into donor_raw in printed order and no name was rearranged. It also carries real City / State / Zip columns, so donor geography exists for this filing; per PRIVACY the Mailing Address line (one row shows a street) and the zip were discarded at read time and only city and state recorded. One expenditure is paid to the CANDIDATE HIMSELF ('11/9/10 Sim Gill / Election Night / $415.54') - recorded as printed. Note this is the 2010 year-end and its Column A figures ARE period figures that reconcile; that is a different filing from the known Gill 2007 report in which Column A carried a prior cumulative total. GEOMETRY: omitted on both attachment pages - they are rotated in opposite directions and their rows are not on a verifiable uniform grid once mapped back to poppler's portrait coordinates, and per the brief a wrong pointer is worse than none.
